source: CHALLENGES.md of DVWS-Node (snoopysecurity/dvws-node e83689c): the challenges whose flaw sits on one line of code, each mapped to that line by reading the code the challenge's endpoint runs. Written before any tool ran on DVWS-Node. Left out: access control, IDOR, CSRF, CORS, rate limits, enumeration, GraphQL introspection/batching and other flaws of design or configuration that no single line carries, plus XSS and CRLF/log injection, whose line the guide does not make clear.
